scope: Ki Blast Super Expert Mission evidence refresh after Batch 321; next unresolved existing partial records

records.name: Death Wave
records.character_source: Frieza (1st Form), Frieza (Final Form), Frieza (Full Power), Dodoria/Janemba/Goku Black customize partners
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 5 — The Galactic Tyrant; current mission documentation lists Death Wave as a Basic Reward.
records.effect: Fires a long-range vertical Ki wave that slashes/knocks back the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current dedicated evidence classifies Death Wave as a Ki Blast Super, 100 Ki, long-range, single-hit knockback, with the documented attack dealing about 15% damage. Independent current-accessible mission documentation corroborates EM5 as the reward endpoint. A separate community report describes repeated damage while a giant Ki blast passes through the wave, but that behavior is treated as community gameplay evidence rather than canonical frame/damage data.
evidence_limits: Do not infer first-clear guarantee from Basic Reward classification.
The 15% figure is source-reported and should not be generalized across versions/builds.
No narrower race/gender/form restriction is asserted.

records.name: Murder Grenade
records.character_source: Nappa; later available in selected partner custom skillsets after purchasing it
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 3 — Assault of the Great Ape; current mission documentation lists Murder Grenade as a Basic Reward.
records.effect: Throws an explosive Ki sphere/grenade that tracks the opponent and can hold them in place through multiple hits.
records.mechanics_notes: Current repository research and external technique documentation agree on EM3 as the Future Warrior acquisition endpoint. The maintained research description records a 100-Ki activation and tracking multi-hit explosive behavior. Current mission documentation independently lists Murder Grenade as the Basic Reward. Post-update partner customization availability is retained as secondary provenance and is not treated as a separate CaC acquisition route.
evidence_limits: Do not infer first-clear guarantee from Basic Reward classification.
No unsupported damage/frame values are promoted.
Partner customization availability does not establish a separate CaC unlock requirement.

evidence_summary.current_evidence: Both records have independently corroborated Expert Mission endpoints and direct Ki Blast Super mechanics evidence.
evidence_summary.remaining_gap: The maintained acquisition index intentionally remains partially_verified because exact drop rates/guarantee semantics are unresolved.
